free_tier.stated: 50,000 records on the Free/Build plan (100K on the paid Grow tier); 10,000 search requests/month

egress.terms: Search requests are the meter, not bytes. 10,000 search requests/month is ~333/day — this is the most brutally op-limited store in the dossier.

tooling: REST API, official SDKs for ~15 languages, `algolia` CLI, InstantSearch widgets; records are JSON only
chaining: 50K records x ~10 KB average = ~500 MB of usable payload per app. Several free apps would need several accounts. Record-size guidance is 'Avg 10KB/Record max 100KB', so the absolute ceiling is 50K x 100 KB = 5 GB, and that requires exceeding the size guidance.
limits_note: 50K records; 10K search requests/month; avg 10 KB/record, max 100 KB/record; JSON only (no binary — base64 must be embedded in a string attribute and bloats the record); indexing operations are separately rate-limited
reliability_note: Extremely reliable CDN-backed search, but it is a search index, not a store: records are tokenized and stored in an inverted index, so storing base64 blobs both inflates size ~33% and destroys index performance. Not usable as blob storage in practice.
confidence_note: One page read moves it to documented.
